findings.title: Completed approved records expose mutation controls
findings.summary: The completed record remained read-only after reload and reopening the same approved applicant. Approve and Return controls were absent; Passport acceptance and bio-comment saving were effectively disabled. Pressing Space on the phone checkbox caused no observed change or verification mutation.
steps: Open the controlled completed Pitcher approval record.
Inspect the read-only notice and effective disabled state of Passport acceptance and bio-comment Save.
Press Space on the apparently enabled phone checkbox; observe no checked-state change or verification mutation.
Inspect the terminal record at all six calibrated Chrome sizes.
Reload, select Completed (12), reopen the same approved applicant, and verify the read-only notice persists with no Approve or Return controls.
